title: Tech View and Board View in the Dark theme (on hold until scope is decided)
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and See financial data, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is 1440 px wide, with the browser zoom at 100%.
  • The design pictures DC-16-tech-view-dark-1440.png and DC-16-board-view-dark-1440.png are open beside the app at 100% zoom (actual size); they are attached to this case.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC16 Xia Dark) is an active technician at {Location-A}.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST DC16 Dark Theme") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17846) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter, Assigned to me is off, Search is empty and density is Regular (the default).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Tech View in the display switcher.
  2. Click your initials (top right) and look for a theme or Dark mode option.
  3. If a Dark option exists, turn it on and look at Tech View, then click Board View and look at it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: no expected result is set yet. The PRD does not say whether Tech View and Board View must support the Dark theme the design offers; this is with the product owner. Write down whether the app offers a Dark theme.
  • Step 3: no expected result is set yet. If a Dark theme exists, keep screenshots of Tech View and Board View beside the attached dark design pictures for the product owner; do not mark the case passed or failed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View), SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 52 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), (no sentence about themes), read 14 Oct 2026; Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", states core__work-orders__tech-regular__dark__1440 and core__work-orders__board-detailed__dark__1440 (design pictures DC-16-tech-view-dark-1440.png, DC-16-board-view-dark-1440.png, rendered from that export at the width in the name), read 14 Oct 2026. Where the PRD says nothing about the look, the design is the source. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

The design offers a Dark theme and its library asks for every screen to be checked in both themes; the PRD is silent, so this case is held until the product owner answers question W-15 (not yet answered).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Design — SKILL.md (design library), checklist: “Rendered and checked in both themes (`ShopviewTheme.set('dark')`).”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - waiting for the product owner's answer on whether the Dark theme is in scope
